pin_title: 6 Christmas Table & Baking Buys Under £15 UK Hosts Love
pin_title_alt: 3 Little Buys That Make Christmas at Home Feel Extra Festive
pin_hook: Set the table and bake the biscuits - all highly rated
pin_description: Get your Christmas dinner table and festive baking sorted for under £15 each: Christmas candle holders, holly napkins, a red table runner, Christmas cookie cutters and Santa cupcake cases. Easy Christmas table decoration ideas and Christmas baking essentials UK hosts rate highly. #ad #christmastable #christmasbaking #christmasdecor #ukdeals
intro: Hosting this Christmas or just love a festive bake? These well-rated table and baking bits make the big day (and the run-up to it) look and taste the part without spending much.

products.name: Sziqiqi Christmas Pillar Candle Holders, 2 Pack
products.headline: Instant candlelit glow for the Christmas table
products.why: A pair of festive pillar candle holders that dress up a dining table or mantelpiece in seconds. Thousands of shoppers rate them, and they come out year after year.

products.name: Talking Tables Holly & Berries Christmas Paper Napkins, 100 Pack
products.headline: Enough festive napkins for every get-together
products.why: A big pack of classic holly-and-berry napkins, so you're covered for Christmas dinner, Boxing Day buffets and drinks with the neighbours.

products.name: Joyoldelf 5-Piece Stainless Steel Christmas Cookie Cutter Set
products.headline: Gingerbread men, trees and snowflakes made easy
products.why: Five classic Christmas shapes in sturdy stainless steel that cut cleanly through biscuit dough. A cheap, cheerful way to start a baking tradition with the kids.

products.name: Red Linen-Look Christmas Table Runner, 230 x 33 cm
products.headline: Makes a plain table feel Christmassy in seconds
products.why: A long red runner printed with trees, bells and flowers that fits most dining tables and pairs nicely with candles and greenery.

products.name: SANNIX Christmas Cupcake Cases, 450 Pack
products.headline: Festive cupcakes before you've even iced them
products.why: Hundreds of Santa and snowman print cases in one pack, so they'll last through school bake sales, parties and Christmas Eve baking.

products.name: Culpitt Select Red Baking Cases, 50 Pack
products.headline: Bold red cases for mince pies and fairy cakes
products.why: Simple, sturdy red cases from a well-known baking brand that look smart on a festive plate. A handy cupboard staple for December baking.
